prompt:
Create unit `tasks` for this task.

Implement `calculate_loss`: `cost_price` and `selling_price` are non-negative 32-bit integers. Return the loss: cost_price - selling_price when the cost exceeds the selling price, otherwise 0. The contract must state the result exactly in both cases.

Required signature (in unit `tasks`):
fn calculate_loss(cost_price: i64, selling_price: i64) -> (r: i64)
signature: fn calculate_loss(cost_price: i64, selling_price: i64) -> (r: i64)

accept.specs:
spec fn ref_pre(cost_price: i64, selling_price: i64) -> bool { -2147483648 <= cost_price && cost_price <= 2147483647 && -2147483648 <= selling_price && selling_price <= 2147483647 && cost_price >= 0 && selling_price >= 0 }
spec fn ref_post(cost_price: i64, selling_price: i64, r: i64) -> bool { (cost_price > selling_price ==> r == cost_price - selling_price) && (cost_price <= selling_price ==> r == 0) }

verus.signature: fn calculate_loss(cost_price: i32, selling_price: i32) -> (loss: i32)
verus.post: (cost_price > selling_price ==> loss == cost_price - selling_price) && (cost_price <= selling_price ==> loss == 0)
